summary: Bail under UAPA; stringent conditions under s.43D(5); prima facie evidence required; connection between medicine purchase and offence doubted; disclosure statement admissibility examined; bail granted to co-accused no.84 considered; no direct link to landmine or murder; prolonged incarceration under Article 21; charges not yet framed; 144 witnesses; trial delay; insufficient material to sustain detention.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.120B, s.302, s.202
Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 s.18, s.19, s.20, s.39
final_judgment: Bail granted; appellants entitled to release on bail subject to conditions.
